instruction.text: Florence has 500ml left in her bottle of milk. Each bowl of cereal requires 150ml of milk. Firstly, how many full bowls of cereal can be filled?
After filling 3 bowls, how much milk would be left in the bottle?
A barrel has 3 litres of oil left. Each motorbike needs 400ml of oil to be filled up. Firstly, how many motorbikes can be filled?
After filling 7 motorbikes, how much oil would be left in the barrel?
Catherine has 2 litres of water available. Each batch of pasta requires 300 ml of water. Firstly, how many batches of pasta can Catherine cook?
After cooking 6 batches of pasta, how much water would Catherine have left?
